profile.notes: Coin-motor PWM on D9. Default for gateway/receiver.

clock_note: received_timestamp_ms is laptop Unix epoch ms. device_timestamp_ms IMU is Arduino millis(). device_timestamp_ms camera is ESP32 millis() when MJPEG headers are present. Clocks are not synchronized; do not treat differences as one-way latency.
sensing_vs_driver_state: Child processes report source health (SENSING_OK / UNKNOWN). That is not ATTENTIVE.
firmware_demo_mode: Arduino demoMode may vibrate from IMU-only heuristics until a vibration_command is received. That is not fused AI.
